newsitem.title: INDIA: S.Korea's LG in India alumina talks.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's LG in India alumina talks.

text.p: State-run Orissa Mining Corporation (OMC) is negotiating with South Korea's LG International Corp to set up a joint venture alumina refinery in the eastern Indian state, officials said on Thursday.
They said the Orissa state government had asked the South Korean firm to submit a detailed project report on the proposed production capacity, capital cost and equity structure.
LG International Corp, a unit of South Korea's LG Group, confirmed it is considering setting up a joint venture alumina refinery with Orissa Mining Corp.
"It is one of our mining, smelting and refining projects for non-ferrous metals," a LG International spokesman told Reuters in Seoul. "There has been no decision or agreement made yet."
The LG International spokesman said the company was undertaking feasibility studies for the project. LG International expects to complete the project this year if the study is favourable, he said.
Orissa has rich deposits of iron ore, coal, limestone and chrome ore, and 1.6 billion tonnes of bauxite reserves.
"We are getting many proposals from South East Asian and Far East countries to set up projects to exploit Orissa's mineral potential," said S.D. Mishra, a senior state government offical.
